parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; inline preference makes AWS and the scientific-ML approaches optional. The general invitation to apply without every qualification does not change those labels.
Scientific ML collapses into machine-learning, whose required mention wins. No alternative group remains with at least two mapped skills.
Climate, weather, hydrology, Earth science, and their dataset specialties are treated literally as domain knowledge rather than additional taxonomy skills.
Computational infrastructure is not automatically expanded to cloud or AI Infrastructure. Training and preprocessing occur within the infrastructure qualification rather than as independent candidate-skill asks.
The unmapped spatiotemporal modeling, data assimilation, and hybrid physics-ML methods are strongly preferred technical approaches; the requested unmapped schema has no requirement field.
Technologies and technical practices mentioned only in responsibilities are excluded.
